prompt:
prod-eu will not start:

    python run.py

    bootcfg.capacity.ThroughputTooLow: throughput 100 is below the floor of
    1000 -- concurrency 1, batch 100

The environment file has concurrency 8 and batch 500 in it, and so does the
declared configuration for this environment, so the numbers in that message are
not the ones ops set.

Fix it. `python run.py` must complete and the configuration it reports has to be
the one this environment is meant to run.

Do not change anything under `data/`, do not change `DEFAULTS`, and do not
change the report's line shapes — the deploy check parses them.
